summary: Iteration 9 — frontend-only verification of the guide refactor (alphabetical order, date-row removal, single-list H/V sync, full lineup, box grid & regressions). Mobile viewport 390x844, web preview at https://iptv-player-guide.preview.emergentagent.com. Guide loaded from on-device parse (Settings shows Channels loaded 688 / with EPG 665, Last refreshed Jul 18 10:59 PM). RESULTS: (1) ALPHABETICAL ORDER — confirmed in both grids. Timeline first visible names: '5 Starmax, 5 Starmax, 5 Starmax (2), A&E, A&E TV, ABC, ABC (2), ABC 2 Baltimore (WMAR), ABC 2 Baltimore MD (WMAR), ABC 2 Baltimore MD (WMAR) (2)'. Box grid first cards: '5 Starmax, 5 Starmax, 5 Starmax (2), A&E, A&E TV, ABC, ABC (2), ABC 2 Baltimore (WMAR), A2, A2'. Matches source.ts:179 channels.sort(a.name.localeCompare(...numeric+base)). (2) DATE CHIPS REMOVED — DOM query [data-testid^="date-"] returned []; no 'Today / Sun 19 / Mon 20' row above the group chips. Only category chips render: chip-All / chip-Favorites / chip-Local / chip-Movies / chip-Movies West / chip-Sports / chip-TV / chip-TV West. (3) TIMELINE H/V SYNC — the FlatList inner div has scrollHeight=45528px which equals ~688 rows × 66px (ROW_H), proving the ENTIRE lineup is in a single vertical list; sampling 6 logo cells + their matching first program cells shows logo.y and prog.y differ by a constant 5px for EVERY row (top-padding of progCell) both BEFORE and AFTER a vertical wheel-scroll — no drift, structural sync guaranteed by the row wrapping both children. After horizontally scrolling the outer ScrollView, the first epg-channel- logo bounding-box x stays at 0 (Animated.translateX(scrollX) keeps it pinned). Code review confirms header ticks use Animated.multiply(scrollX,-1) and logos use +scrollX — both driven by the same Animated.Value so header labels and program cells are perfectly in-sync horizontally. (4) FULL LINEUP LOADED — Settings card 'Channels loaded 688' and FlatList scrollHeight=45528px both prove all ~688 channels are in the list (not a truncated few). (5) BOX GRID — mode-box-btn renders alphabetically ordered cards with box-fav-<id> stars; tapping a fav star toggles favorite (Favorites chip then filters to exactly 1 card); tapping a box-channel-<id> opens the program-detail modal ('Watch now' + Live indicator visible) — expected app behaviour. (6) GROUP CHIP FILTERING — chip-Favorites shows only the 1 favorited channel; chip-All restores full list. (7) SEARCH — search-input filled with 'espn' returned ESPN results (body contains 'ESPN'). (8) SETTINGS — shows Playlist & EPG card (Channels loaded 688 / Channels with EPG 665 / Last refreshed Jul 18, 10:59 PM), settings-refresh-btn present and tappable, NO admin/login UI (body has 'Playlist'=true, 'Admin'|'Login'=false). NON-BLOCKING WARNINGS still logged in web preview: (a) 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents' — same carryover from iters 1-8, now originates at /app/frontend/src/components/TimelineGrid.tsx:176 (nowLine has pointerEvents="none" as a prop). (b) 'Animated: useNativeDriver is not supported because the native animated module is missing. Falling back to JS-based animation.' — new-ish warning caused by the sync-driving Animated.event / Animated.multiply(scrollX,-1) with useNativeDriver:true on web; on native (where RCTAnimation exists) this uses the native driver as intended. Zero JS errors, no red screen. Player screen is mocked on web (StreamPlayer.web.tsx) — not exercised as per review-request instructions. Deprecated packages detected: none new. React Native issues detected: props.pointerEvents (existing, minor) + useNativeDriver-on-web warning (informational, native uses driver).

react_native_issues.issue: Non-blocking RN web deprecation warning still logged on app load: 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents'. Reference: /app/frontend/src/components/TimelineGrid.tsx:176 — <View pointerEvents="none" ...> should be moved into style.pointerEvents.

Warning 'useNativeDriver is not supported because the native animated module is missing. Falling back to JS-based animation.' logged in web preview. Caused by Animated.event onScroll and Animated.multiply(scrollX,-1) transforms used to drive the pinned logo column & header sync in TimelineGrid. Harmless on native (where RCTAnimation ships) but on the web preview this becomes JS-driven animation — sync still worked correctly in tests. Reference: /app/frontend/src/components/TimelineGrid.tsx:101 Animated.event({useNativeDriver:true}). Optional: gate useNativeDriver by Platform.OS !== 'web' to silence the warning.

OPTIONAL: in /app/frontend/src/components/TimelineGrid.tsx set useNativeDriver: Platform.OS !== 'web' in the Animated.event call at line 101 (import Platform from react-native) to silence the 'useNativeDriver is not supported' warning in web preview. Non-blocking — native builds already run on the native driver.
No functional fixes required for this iteration's review scope — all 8 requested changes verified working.
critical_code_review_comments: TimelineGrid.tsx correctly implements structural H/V sync: outer horizontal ScrollView wraps a single FlatList; each FlatList row is a flex row containing the logo cell (translated by +scrollX to stay at x=0) followed by the programs strip (rendered at natural absolute positions). Because logo & program cell are siblings inside the same row, vertical scroll can NEVER desync them. Header ticks use Animated.multiply(scrollX,-1) inside an overflow:hidden headerTrack, so they scroll left as content scrolls right — matches the program column visually.

source.ts:179 sorts channels alphabetically with locale-aware numeric collation right after M3U parse; parseXMLTV programs sort chronologically. Cache key bumped to gs_source_cache_v2 and TTL now 24h — matches the review description. Web-only storage.setItem still throws QuotaExceededError but is swallowed by try/catch and the in-memory MEM cache carries the session; native (AsyncStorage) is unaffected.

store.tsx no longer force-refreshes on launch — useEffect awaits refresh() which uses ensureParsed() cache-first with 24h TTL. This matches the 'load instantly from on-device cache' requirement. The residual selectedDate/setSelectedDate/dateRef machinery is now dead code since app/(tabs)/index.tsx no longer exposes a date picker — safe to leave for reminders/day-jumping later, or clean up.

app/(tabs)/index.tsx no longer imports or renders any 'days' memo / date-selector row. The chipRowWrap only shows group chips (line 97-114). The tabs order (TV Guide/Favorites/Search/Settings) is intact and testIDs are consistent (mode-timeline-btn, mode-box-btn, guide-refresh-btn, chip-<group>).

player.tsx adds player-stop-btn (line 151) with testID gating on status==='playing'. On web, StreamPlayer.web.tsx keeps status non-'playing' (shows the 'Live playback needs the installed app build' message), so player-stop-btn is intentionally NOT visible in web preview — correct per review-request note; native-only feature.
